name: Protein-sparing modified fast

card.summary: A very-low-calorie, protein-centred diet used for rapid fat loss while aiming to keep muscle, giving a leaner, more defined look.
card.note: Clinical versions are medically supervised; unsupervised very-low-calorie diets are linked to muscle loss, gallstones and electrolyte problems.

quick.overview:
The protein-sparing modified fast (PSMF) is a very-low-calorie diet made up mostly of protein with very little carbohydrate and fat. It was developed in clinical nutrition to produce large, rapid fat loss in people with obesity while limiting the loss of lean tissue.

In physique and bodybuilding circles it is used as a short cut-phase to get lean quickly, since less body fat makes muscle definition and facial leanness more visible. Clinical reviews describe it as effective for fast weight loss under supervision, with caveats about regain and risks.
quick.how: Followers eat lean protein sources and non-starchy vegetables with supplements, usually for limited blocks of weeks and often alongside resistance training to help keep muscle. Medical programmes use calorie intakes in the range of roughly 400 to 800 per day with monitoring and a structured return to normal eating.
quick.risks: Documented concerns include loss of lean mass, gallstones, constipation, electrolyte disturbances and a lower resting metabolic rate during weight loss. Liquid protein diets in the late 1970s were linked to deaths in the US. Clinical guidance describes candidates as people with substantial weight to lose and recommends medical supervision.

lead: The protein-sparing modified fast (PSMF) is a very-low-calorie diet that provides most of its energy as protein, with fluids, vitamins and minerals, and very little carbohydrate or fat. A 1978 JAMA paper and earlier 1970s research from George Blackburn's group set out the approach as a way to cut calories sharply while limiting nitrogen (muscle protein) loss [3][4][5].

Looks-wise, the appeal is speed: it produces fast fat loss, and lower body fat reveals muscle definition and sharper facial contours. Forum members on T Nation have discussed running PSMF blocks for several weeks to get lean before an event or holiday, while some users say they are unsold on fasting-style approaches for staying strong and muscular [1][2].

Clinical reviews describe it as effective for losing a large amount of weight relatively quickly when used with exercise, behaviour change and education [6]. The same literature raises long-term weight regain, muscle loss and medical risks [7][8].

chain: Very low calories with high protein
Rapid fat loss while protein aims to protect lean mass
Leaner body and more visible muscle definition
angle.text: PSMF is used as a short, aggressive cutting phase. The high protein intake is meant to preserve muscle while body fat falls quickly.

infobox: About 400-800 kcal per day in clinical descriptions [6]

paras: In clinical form the diet gives protein in the range of 1.2 to 1.4 g per kg of ideal body weight with fluids freely and vitamin and mineral supplements; ketone bodies rise and hunger is described as well controlled [4]. The ketogenic state is credited with suppressing appetite [9].

A review of George Blackburn's work describes protein-sparing therapies as developed to limit nitrogen losses in acute illness and in hypocaloric diets for obesity [5]. Studies in the 1970s examined nitrogen metabolism in obese diabetic adults and in mildly obese subjects on the diet [4][10], and a 1978 JAMA article discussed its clinical use [3]. A 1985 report described results in 668 outpatients treated with a multidisciplinary programme built around it [11].
A separate history of very-low-calorie diets notes that 58 people died in the US in 1978 after using liquid protein diets, after which the FDA required warnings on some products [12].

On T Nation, members have logged PSMF blocks of about six weeks as a way to reduce body fat before a deadline, monitoring energy levels and planning to increase food if needed [2]. Others describe trying it as a personal experiment while questioning how it fits with building size and strength [1].

A 1990 American Family Physician review calls it a safe and effective method for losing a large amount of weight relatively quickly, to be combined with exercise, behaviour change and education, for people with at least 40 lb to lose [6]. A 2014 Cleveland Clinic review examines benefits in weight loss, glycemic control and cardiovascular risk factors in type 2 diabetes [13].
A 1982 review noted that rapid weight loss from fasting and PSMF tends to be followed by gradual regain in long-term follow-ups [7].

A study of seven obese women found resting metabolic rate fell 22 percent when the modified fast began and stayed depressed during weight maintenance [8]. Very-low-calorie diets in general are associated with lean mass decline, gallstones, constipation and electrolyte imbalance that can affect heart rhythm when unmonitored [12]. Reviews list medical supervision and appropriate candidate selection as part of clinical protocols [6][7].

Randomised and controlled trials include a 2023 open-label trial of a PSMF formula given by nasogastric tube versus orally in adults with a BMI above 34.9 [14], a 1985 comparison of PSMF with a protein-formula liquid diet [15] and a 1987 controlled study of appetite and symptoms on the diet [16]. A 2023 report examined preoperative PSMF before bariatric surgery [17]. These studies were carried out in people with obesity rather than in lean physique-focused dieters.

timeline.event: Study of nitrogen metabolism and insulin requirements in obese diabetic adults on a protein-sparing modified fast published in Diabetes [10].
JAMA publishes 'Clinical use of a protein-sparing modified fast' [3]; 58 deaths among US liquid protein dieters lead to FDA warnings [12].
Results from 668 outpatients treated with a PSMF-based programme reported [11].
American Family Physician review of the approach [6].
Randomised trial of PSMF by nasogastric tube published [14].

lore.intro: On T Nation, PSMF appears in training logs as a short cutting tool and as an experiment [1][2].

claims.claim: PSMF strips fat fast while the protein keeps muscle.
claims.believers: Log authors run multi-week blocks to get lean quickly [2].
claims.experts: Clinical reviews report rapid weight loss with preserved protein balance versus total fasting, but also lean mass concerns with very-low-calorie diets [4][12].

claims.claim: Fasting-style dieting does not suit building strength and size.
claims.believers: One member says he is unsold on fasting for being jacked and strong [1].
claims.experts: Resting metabolic rate has been reported to fall during the modified fast [8].
